lines.zh: 菌丝代替脚，一步一软地挪。
lines.en: Mycelium serves as feet, soft with every step.

lines.zh: 我顶着伞盖走，像举着一把湿伞。
lines.en: I walk under my own cap like a wet umbrella.

lines.zh: 骨骸在菌肉里响，走一步响一下。
lines.en: Bone rattles inside my flesh, once per step.

lines.zh: 我沿着背阴的坡走，太阳晒得菌褶发干。
lines.en: I keep to shaded slopes; sun dries my gills.

lines.zh: 我的步子很小，因为我怕把腿走断。
lines.en: My steps are short; I fear breaking my own legs.

lines.zh: 走过的地方会留下白色的丝。
lines.en: White threads trail behind wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，伞盖太重了。
lines.en: I lean as I walk; the cap is too heavy.

lines.zh: 我的腿很短，走起来像在蹦。
lines.en: My legs are short, and I move in little hops.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，菌丝不喜欢硬东西。
lines.en: I go around stones; mycelium dislikes hard things.

lines.zh: 每一步都带出一点腐叶的味道。
lines.en: Each step releases a little smell of rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 我边走边抖，抖掉多余的孢子。
lines.en: I shake as I walk, shedding extra spores.

lines.zh: 夜里的路我看得比白天清楚。
lines.en: I see the night road better than the day one.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，让孢子慢慢落下来。
lines.en: I stand still and let the spores drift down.

lines.zh: 伞盖下很暗，正好够我待着。
lines.en: It is dark under my cap, just enough for me.

lines.zh: 风一来，我的菌褶就自己抖。
lines.en: When wind comes, my gills ruffle on their own.

lines.zh: 我在想那锅炖菜的味道。
lines.en: I am thinking of the taste of that stew.

lines.zh: 有个声音卡在我喉咙里，出不来。
lines.en: A sound is stuck in my throat and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地长，长一点就疼一点。
lines.en: I grow slowly, and every bit of growth aches.

lines.zh: 白天我缩成一个小包，等天黑。
lines.en: By day I shrink into a small lump and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 菌丝在土里替我喝水，我不用动。
lines.en: Mycelium drinks for me in the soil; I need not move.

lines.zh: 我把孢子留在石头上，做记号。
lines.en: I leave spores on the stone as a marker.

lines.zh: 安静时我能听见土在呼吸。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear the soil breathing.

lines.zh: 你身上有炖菜的味道，很淡。
lines.en: You carry the smell of stew, faint but there.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，菌褶全张开了。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you and my gills open wide.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我伞盖上，凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my cap, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 你是来倒汤的那个吗。
lines.en: Are you the one who came to pour the soup?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，怕你又拿错罐子。
lines.en: I watch your hands, afraid you will take the wrong jar.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛太亮了，我往暗处躲。
lines.en: Your eyes are too bright; I shrink toward the dark.

lines.zh: 我以前也有一张脸，现在只剩这个。
lines.en: I once had a face; now only this is left.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，菌丝在土里缩了一下。
lines.en: When you look at me, my mycelium flinches in the soil.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味让我想起那把铲子。
lines.en: The iron smell on you recalls that shovel.

lines.zh: 我没有眼皮，只能一直看着你。
lines.en: I have no eyelids, so I can only keep watching you.

lines.zh: 你站远一点，孢子会落在你衣服上。
lines.en: Stand farther back; spores will settle on your clothes.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝的脚步声，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the way your steps snap dry twigs.

lines.zh: 你别笑，我看不懂笑。
lines.en: Do not smile; I cannot read smiles.

lines.zh: 你低头的时候，我想起自己倒下那刻。
lines.en: When you bow your head, I recall the moment I fell.

lines.zh: 你砍掉一角伞盖，白水冒出来。
lines.en: You shear off a corner of my cap and white fluid wells.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我会叫，很难听。
lines.en: When it hurts I cry out, and it is ugly.

lines.zh: 我的菌肉在合拢，只是慢一点。
lines.en: My flesh is closing, only slowly.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在骨头上，声音很脆。
lines.en: The blade hits bone with a brittle sound.

lines.zh: 我抖得厉害，孢子全掉了。
lines.en: I shake hard and lose most of my spores.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的腿，我还能爬。
lines.en: You broke my leg; I can still crawl.

lines.zh: 别碰断口，那里最疼。
lines.en: Do not touch the stump; that is where it hurts most.

lines.zh: 我闻到自己的味道，很腥。
lines.en: I smell my own fluids, and they are rank.

lines.zh: 这点伤，长一晚上就好了。
lines.en: A night's growth will mend this.

lines.zh: 你打我的时候，我记住了你的脸。
lines.en: While you struck me, I memorized your face.

lines.zh: 是生命炖菜吗，我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that life stew? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 那罐东西一开，我的菌丝全竖起来。
lines.en: The moment that jar opens, all my mycelium rises.

lines.zh: 别拿炼狱混合物，那会把我变回去。
lines.en: Not the infernal mixture; that would change me back.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，骨头里都是空的。
lines.en: I have been hungry long; my bones are hollow.

lines.zh: 你把碗放下，我就靠近一点。
lines.en: Set the bowl down and I will come a little nearer.

lines.zh: 这个味道让我想站起来。
lines.en: This smell makes me want to stand up.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候会抖，别笑。
lines.en: I shake while eating; do not laugh at me.

lines.zh: 汤是热的，我的舌头早就没了。
lines.en: The soup is hot, and my tongue is long gone.

lines.zh: 你的手别伸进来，我会咬。
lines.en: Do not reach your hand in; I will bite it.

lines.zh: 再给一勺，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more spoonful and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，孢子全扑到你脸上。
lines.en: You bump me and a cloud of spores hits your face.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖很软，撞上去像撞湿被。
lines.en: My cap is soft, like a wet quilt to the touch.

lines.zh: 别推，我的骨头会错位。
lines.en: Do not push; my bones will shift out of place.

lines.zh: 我们一碰，菌丝就缠在一起了。
lines.en: One touch and our mycelium tangles together.

lines.zh: 你退开时，衣服上多了白点。
lines.en: As you pull back, white spots appear on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了两步，伞盖歪了。
lines.en: I stumble two steps and my cap tips over.

lines.zh: 撞我的代价是咳一整天。
lines.en: The price of bumping me is a whole day of coughing.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚边的菌丝，我抽了一下。
lines.en: You step on my mycelium and I jerk.

lines.zh: 这具身体比看上去轻。
lines.en: This stalk of borrowed fungus weighs almost nothing.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上有湿气。
lines.en: Do not press close; I am damp all over.

lines.zh: 我们不需要同类，孢子就够了。
lines.en: We need no partner; spores are enough.

lines.zh: 两朵伞盖并在一起，像两把伞躲雨。
lines.en: Two caps lean together, two umbrellas in rain.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒给你，你接住就好。
lines.en: I scatter spores to you; just catch them.

lines.zh: 我的根和你的根在土下碰了一下。
lines.en: My roots brushed yours under the soil.

lines.zh: 夜里我们并排站着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: At night we stand side by side and say nothing.

lines.zh: 一起待久了，菌丝会分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Stay long enough and our mycelium cannot tell us apart.

lines.zh: 我没有伴，只有一片会长的白。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a whiteness that keeps growing.

lines.zh: 你也有伞盖吗，借我挡一会儿。
lines.en: Do you have a cap too? Lend it a while.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，土里就多了一圈丝。
lines.en: Pressed together, a new ring of threads forms below.

lines.zh: 分开时，我的伞盖缺了一角。
lines.en: When we part, my cap is missing a corner.

lines.zh: 我用菌丝卷起东西，很慢，但稳。
lines.en: I lift things with mycelium: slowly, but steady.

lines.zh: 那根骨头是我的，别动。
lines.en: That bone is mine; leave it alone.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西会陷进我的丝里。
lines.en: Whatever falls sinks into my threads.

lines.zh: 我捡起碗，舔了很久。
lines.en: I pick up the bowl and lick it for a long time.

lines.zh: 我没有手指，只能用整只手去捧。
lines.en: I have no fingers; I must scoop with the whole hand.

lines.zh: 你掉的汤勺，我替你收着了。
lines.en: You dropped a spoon; I have kept it for you.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候我会蹲下来，很慢。
lines.en: I crouch to pick things up, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这块布上有炖菜的味道。
lines.en: This cloth smells of stew.

lines.zh: 我把孢子留在你的口袋边上。
lines.en: I leave spores along the edge of your pocket.

lines.zh: 太重了，我只拖得动一小段。
lines.en: It is too heavy; I can drag it only a little way.

lines.zh: 你手里那罐东西，让我盯上你了。
lines.en: That jar in your hand is why I marked you.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的菌圈，我记住了。
lines.en: You crushed my ring of mushrooms, and I remember.

lines.zh: 你走得太近，我以为是来收我的。
lines.en: You come too close; I take you for a harvester.

lines.zh: 我竖起伞盖，那是警告。
lines.en: I raise my cap; that is the warning.

lines.zh: 你身上的体温，让我的骨头痒。
lines.en: The warmth of you makes my bones itch.

lines.zh: 你不是倒汤的人，那就不用客气。
lines.en: You are not the soup-pourer, so no courtesy is owed.

lines.zh: 我看见你抬手，就先动了。
lines.en: I see your hand rise and move first.

lines.zh: 这一片阴凉是我的。
lines.en: This patch of shade belongs to me.

lines.zh: 你踩断的菌丝还在流白水。
lines.en: The mycelium you snapped still leaks white.

lines.zh: 你袖口有火把的焦味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of burnt torch, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔一丛草了。
lines.en: Only one clump of grass lies between us.

lines.zh: 我决定今晚不吃素的。
lines.en: I have decided not to eat plants tonight.

lines.zh: 你的脚印压过我的孢子，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your footprints press into my spores, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你停下来看我，那就先拿你试试。
lines.en: You stop to look at me, so I shall try you first.

lines.zh: 你手里的碗不是给我的，我闻得出。
lines.en: That bowl isn't for me; I can smell the difference.

lines.zh: 我压低伞盖，慢慢横着挪。
lines.en: I lower my cap and edge sideways.

lines.zh: 你退，我的菌丝就从土里追。
lines.en: Retreat, and my mycelium chases through the soil.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚落进丝里。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to settle into my threads.

lines.zh: 你听，骨头在响，那是倒数。
lines.en: Listen: the bones are rattling, and that is a countdown.

lines.zh: 我绕到背光的一面，你找不到我。
lines.en: I move to the unlit side where you cannot find me.

lines.zh: 每次你转身，我就近半步。
lines.en: Each time you turn, I gain half a step.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会浪费力气。
lines.en: I stay silent; noise would spend strength I need.

lines.zh: 菌褶在抖，那是我在笑。
lines.en: My gills are quivering; that is how I laugh.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝里有味道，我闻得到。
lines.en: There is a scent in your armor's seams, and I smell it.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒在你脚边，慢慢来。
lines.en: I scatter spores at your feet and take my time.

lines.zh: 你抬头看树，我在看你的喉咙。
lines.en: You look at the trees; I look at your throat.

lines.zh: 别跑向亮处，那里没有我的影子。
lines.en: Do not run for the light; my shadow does not reach there.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我越不着急。
lines.en: The harder you pant, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，一步也不差。
lines.en: I keep your step count, and I never lose one.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑过来，伞盖压得很低。
lines.en: I slide along the ground with my cap pressed low.

lines.zh: 你踩过的土里，菌丝已经醒了。
lines.en: The mycelium in your footprints has already woken.

lines.zh: 我不和你对视，我只盯着你的脚。
lines.en: I avoid your eyes and watch only your feet.

lines.zh: 你转身找我的时候，我就在原地。
lines.en: When you turn to find me, I'm still right here.

lines.zh: 我整朵扑上去，用伞盖压你。
lines.en: I throw my whole cap down on you.

lines.zh: 骨头从菌肉里顶出来，扎进你手臂。
lines.en: Bone pushes out of my flesh and into your arm.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，嘴里全是孢子。
lines.en: I bite down and my mouth fills with spores.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，可你会咳很久。
lines.en: The blow is light, but you will cough for hours.

lines.zh: 我用断掉的那条腿踢你。
lines.en: I kick you with the leg that already broke.

lines.zh: 菌丝缠住你的脚踝，然后我撞过去。
lines.en: Mycelium binds your ankle, then I charge.

lines.zh: 别擦，孢子在伤口里长得更快。
lines.en: Do not wipe it; spores grow faster in a wound.

lines.zh: 我打得难看，但每一下都带毒。
lines.en: My fighting is ugly, but every hit carries poison.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我就把断口对着你喷。
lines.en: Cut me and I spray the stump at you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的骨头在响，很好听。
lines.en: I hear your bones ring, and it is a pleasant sound.

lines.zh: 我扑空了，摔进自己的菌丝里。
lines.en: I miss and tumble into my own mycelium.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我的伞盖塌了半边。
lines.en: After that charge, half my cap has caved in.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖撞在你胸口，全是粉。
lines.en: My cap strikes your chest and bursts with dust.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，哪怕牙留在你身上。
lines.en: I hold on, even if my teeth stay in you.

lines.zh: 我用硬伞边磕你的膝弯。
lines.en: I crack the rim of my cap against the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一撞散了粉，你咳得停不下来。
lines.en: The hit bursts my spores and you can't stop coughing.

lines.zh: 汤倒下来，我从骨骸里长出来。
lines.en: The stew pours down, and I grow out of the bones.

lines.zh: 先是白色的丝，然后才是伞盖。
lines.en: First the white threads, then the cap.

lines.zh: 我在那具倒下的身体里醒过来。
lines.en: I wake inside that fallen body.

lines.zh: 生命炖菜的味道一散，我就动了。
lines.en: The smell of life stew spreads, and I move.

lines.zh: 骨头撑起菌肉，我站了起来。
lines.en: Bone props up the fungal flesh, and I stand.

lines.zh: 我睁眼看见的第一样东西是铲子。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a shovel.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，只发出咕的一声。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only croak.

lines.zh: 这一片阴湿的地方，正适合我。
lines.en: This damp shaded place suits me well.

lines.zh: 我长得比谁想的都快。
lines.en: I grow faster than anyone expected.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在数到三。
lines.en: I hear someone counting to three.

lines.zh: 孢子先落下来，我才成形。
lines.en: The spores fall first, and then I take shape.

lines.zh: 我带着一段不属于自己的记忆。
lines.en: I carry a memory that is not mine.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖伞盖，把土抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my cap and the soil falls away.

lines.zh: 我落地时抖出一圈白粉。
lines.en: I land and shake out a ring of white dust.

lines.zh: 火一舔伞盖，我整个人缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire licks my cap and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候，伞盖替我垫了一下。
lines.en: As I fall, my cap takes the impact.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌褶，我浮起来又沉下去。
lines.en: Water fills my gills; I float, then sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的孢子吹成一片白雾。
lines.en: The blast blows my spores into white mist.

lines.zh: 箭钉在伞盖上，像插了一根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my cap like a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水一泼，菌丝全缩回骨里。
lines.en: A potion splash sends my mycelium into the bone.

lines.zh: 土里没有东西可吸，我只能干等。
lines.en: Nothing left to draw from the soil; I can only wait.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的伞盖烧穿一个洞。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and burns a hole through my cap.

lines.zh: 虚空把孢子吹散，我拼了很久才回来。
lines.en: The void scatters my spores; I took long to return.
